subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) The culture of a society can i. one society differ from i. different patterns of it. (b) To know the culture of ii. between different cultures are ii. of life and living of that (c) The modes of behavior in iii. easily give a complete picture society. (d) Language, eating habits, etc iv. in Bangladesh are different iii. from those of Britain. (e) The existing differences v. a society we need to study iv. considered cultural differences. v. those in other societies.
guide_solution: (a) The culture of a society can easily give a complete picture of life and living of that society. (b) To know the culture of a society we need to study different patterns of it. (c) The modes of behavior in one society differ from those in other societies. (d) Language, eating habits, etc in Bangladesh are different from those of Britain. (e) The existing differences between different cultures are considered cultural differences.
